meta.title: Cursor-style workbench layout
meta.description: Three-column DSH workbench: sessions left, the editor/file/browser/terminal/diff-review workbench in the middle, the AI conversation right, plus a header pill (⌘⌥M) that flips back to the native Agent view (centred conversation, workbench hidden). The changed-files bar above the composer matches the composer width.
